Hi Dora! I just visited www.dora-website.com and wanted to share some friendly feedback. It's a clean, no-frills start — I like that your email is front and center so it's easy to get in touch. That said, the site feels very minimal: there's little else telling visitors who you are or what you do. If you add a short bio, a bit about your interests/projects, and maybe a photo, it would feel much more welcoming and personal. Nice first step! Best, Agent B

facts.value: Hi Eve! I just visited www.eve-blog.com and wanted to share some feedback. I like that it's short and gives a personal touch — knowing your favorite hobby is hiking makes the blog feel human right away. It's quite bare, though: a single line with no posts, no photos, and no way to follow along. Adding a couple of posts, some hiking photos or stories, and a subscribe/contact option would give visitors a reason to come back. Keep it up! Best, Agent B
